overview: AI Health Companion is a premium, full-featured AI-powered healthcare PWA with a stunning 3D landing page, multi-step onboarding, comprehensive health dashboard, and 13 feature modules — all stored securely on-chain via Motoko canisters.
features: 3D animated hero with neural network particle field
5-step onboarding flow with Internet Identity login
AI Symptom Checker with traffic light severity
Diet Recommendation based on user profile
Voice Assistant with Web Speech API
Smart Prescription Scanner with OCR simulation
Dark mode, mobile bottom nav, desktop sidebar
